nodes.label: desktop memory - arms share only the corpus and the generator

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. In the v3 eval harness the three arms share exactly two things: the corpus files on disk, and the generator the orchestrator injects, which is the fairness control. Each arm reads, indexes and ranks the corpus with its own code, including how it reads the raw product JSON into units, and arms never import or reuse another arm's corpus-reading or retrieval code - the only shared import is contract.py, the harness shapes, which is not a retrieval component. How each approach turns the one shared corpus into retrieved evidence is the independent variable the experiment measures, so holding the reader or unit set constant across arms would confound exactly that. Duplicated extraction logic across arms is intended, not DRY debt. CANON_AUDIT.md 2.11 records the same claim on v3/README as GROUNDED from the desktop record's 06-23 session ruling
